assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, unstranded, Illumina NovaSeq PE150), mouse gastrocnemius
sample_inclusion: 20/21-month-old male chow (4.8% fat)-fed Nox4 fl/fl (n=4) and Mck-Cre;Nox4 fl/fl (n=4) mice; no exercise intervention in the sequenced cohort (S2.3.p4, FIG4)
primary_estimand: Effect of muscle-specific NOX4 deficiency on gastrocnemius gene expression in aged sedentary-housed mice (genotype effect, not an exercise effect)
planned_contrasts: Mck-Cre;Nox4 fl/fl vs Nox4 fl/fl, aged gastrocnemius (S2.3.p4, fig. S14A; paper: 1023 DEGs = 443 up, 580 down)
exercise_experiments_in_paper: Treadmill training (5 wk, 3 d/wk) was done in 12-month-old mice (S4.4.3.p1, Fig. 6) and assessed by qPCR/immunoblot only; human GSE159217 (young vs old) and GSE141910 are reanalyses of other series. None of these are in GSE315575.
paper_results: 1023 DEGs (443 up, 580 down) KO vs control; GO/KEGG ORA of down genes (FDR<0.01); GSEA KEAP1/NFE2L2 NES -2.388, curated NFE2L2 set NES -1.88; Cybb not changed
